payload.name: Retrieve event news by explicit date
payload.description: Apply when a question states an exact calendar date and asks what news, event, or information someone shared or received on that date. Use it to add a structured date-filtered search if the initial results contain no memory dated that day.
content: When a question specifies an exact date and asks for news/event/information shared on that date, check whether any returned memory has a world_start matching that date.
If none does, run one structured search with a world_start filter equal to the question's date and a modest top_k (e.g., 5-10).
Stop after that structured search unless it returns a date-matching memory; do not search nearby dates or re-query with different wording.

solves: Memory text often omits the date even though the event is dated in metadata, so hybrid searches miss exact-date queries; one structured search filtered by that date fixes it. Applies when a question asks what news/event/information was shared on a stated date and the first search returns nothing dated that day. Not for date-less questions, incidental dates, or when an initial result already has the right date.
